subject: planner: refactor outer to inner join (#63637)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent (993231d2133c44c5c81a3784c23c048916860cb4). Core change moves outer→inner join simplification into `LogicalJoin.PredicatePushDown` via `simplifyOuterJoin()` + a new null-reject check (`isNullRejected`, using `EvaluateExprWithNull` + special-case for #49616), and removes `FlagConvertOuterToInnerJoin` from plan builder so the old rule is no longer enabled by default. Checked join predicate pushdown paths (incl. Apply) and the new regression test for #58836 (window+apply) that ensures scalar-subquery Apply stays `left outer join` to avoid row-number semantics break. No remaining Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, transaction/session, or privilege issues found in the touched planner/executor behavior.
